reviews.title: Oh dear, oh dear
reviews.text: We suffered flight changes, times, dates which reeked havoc with our ground transfers. Eventually we had to cancel the flight and travel by overnight bus. Although about the same price we arrived earlier than the plane due to the times of the flights. I had a subsequent flight a few days later from Guatemala City to Cancun. Again, times were changed for ‘operational ‘ reasons. However, this flight did take off with just 4 people. That was a good experience but I wonder if they had not needed to fly to Cancun pick up passengers, would they have cancelled………..
reviews.author: BobCScotinWales

reviews.title: Flight went ahead with no issues
reviews.text: Had a very easy flight with them that left on time. Its approx a 30 seater plane, only 12 people on the plane and it went ahead with no issues! Was worried intially as skyscanner had said there was a flight two days before mine but it never existed!! But adjusted our plans and booked a flight for two days later and it was a dream. Price looked to never change and we booked a few weeks out but would be the same if you booked day before. Very friendly staff and small little airport. No mention of cancelling it either. Really recommend it but was worried given the reviews.
reviews.author: Philip S

reviews.title: Coolest flight of my life!
reviews.text: It is not common to fly for Guatemala City to Quetzaltenango, that's why tripadvisor does not even know the airport and it was a required field so I had to fill in Flores. It made sense for me because I wanted to do the Quetzaltrekkers trek to Lake Atitlan the next day and I had to get there quickly. The staff at the airport was extremely friendly and was teasing me about the smallness of this plane, because they had to weigh not only the luggage but also the passengers. They were not wrong! It was a plane that could transport 12 people at maximum, and we were with 3 passengers. If I ever flew a plane with a propeller than it was a very long time ago. I could sit right behind the pilot and had a great view of Guatemala because the plane does not fly as high as other aircraft. The pilot and steward were extremely relaxed and friendly. After one hour we arrived in the airport of Quetzaltenango which had maybe 2 employees? One person doing the signaling and one guard. All in all it was a great experience and didn't feel as just getting from a to b for me. Considering the small plane being almost a private flight, the time you save and the fact that they often rip you off by asking way to much for the shuttles it was not that expensive actually and I totally recommend it!
reviews.author: Steven G

reviews.title: Scared after reading reviews - but everything worked out!
reviews.text: We decided to book our flight with TAG because it was the cheapest and only nonstop flight. We were super skeptical after reading the reviews about cancelled flights, missing luggage, terrible customer services, but overall our flight was pleasant. The airline is very clear about arriving 2 hours before the flight, and we did, but there wasn't anyone on the counter and we waited for 20 minutes. Other than that, the whole experience was as expected for an airline.
reviews.author: Audra A

reviews.title: An Awesome Old Saab Ride to Guatemala City!
reviews.text: Perhaps you can now book a modern A320 on Avianca on the same route, but there’s something truly special about opting to fly Guatemala’s national airline, TAG, on a classic aircraft like the Saab 340. As an avgeek, I was not disappointed. This was my first flight on a Saab, and I’m lucky to have been able to board one before their eventual extinction worldwide. And rather than flying on one over flat, uninteresting terrain, to ride over the gorgeous mountains and waters of Guatemala made the trip all the more exciting! The staff working for TAG were all very kind and professional. Cabin crews are well-trained and prioritize safety like any other familiar carrier. The flight was on-time, and while not the most comfortable and quiet aircraft, the old-school approach to reaching GUA is worth the mild discomfort. (Note that the airline does have other planes in their fleet, in case you’re not an avgeek!) Download movies in advance if you’re on a longer flight! The ticket price I paid was expensive, but most intra-Central America flights are pricey. It wasn’t a bad price at all. I loved every minute of my time on TAG, and I can’t wait to fly them again!
reviews.author: The Autistic Traveler

reviews.title: worst experience ever!
reviews.text: Because of their lack of information, cooperation and integration with digital platforms they made me lose my flight. I had to stay one day in Guatemala. Next day, came to take the same flight they made me lost and what happens? Again! They change the flight with no previous notice and the people from the counter acting very rude and impolite. They know their system sucks but they act like it’s not their problem. I hope this comment can save someone’s time.
reviews.author: Esteban S

reviews.title: Wouldn't let us into our flight, 40 mins before flight even left.
reviews.text: Plane was scheduled to leave at 9 am, we got there at 8:20 am - knowing from past experiences this airport is super small and everything from check in to getting to your gate takes up to 10 mins max. When we got there, they immediately turned us down - saying the plane was closed. Mind you, this was 8:20 am. We could see the people sitting just outside the gate waiting for boarding to start RIGHT next to us (like I said, small airport). We were confused, had our reservation, our seat numbers and we were there... even before boarding even started, which it did 15 minutes later. Apparently they have a policy that they can deny anyone who doesnt show up 45 minutes before departure - a policy that wasnt in our ticket reservations and was never mailed to us. They kept referring to it as being pasted on their desk (handwritten on a paper) and counter window- as if I was to know about it being pasted there before or go at some point a few days before to see it there. They literally made no sense and when asked about the reasoning behind this policy they couldn't. They just kept repeating "it is a policy". Meanwhile they were not doing anything, just sitting there on their desk chatting with each other - instead of finding a way to help us or actually checking us in to the flight. They were not understanding to us in any way. No sign of reasoning either. They just kept telling us that we lost the seat and it was not refundable. All of this while the people were still seating NEXT to us waiting for onboarding to being. I kept asking for clarification and telling them that the plane would now have two empty seats. They agreed that yes, the plane would leave with two empty seats....I was honest and told them that even in an international airport where there is more movement, multiple flights, and higher volume of people trying to get to their plane - they would still do anything to make sure passengers get to their gate. And once again, they agreed with me on it. Complete disregard for paying customers. I feel this was an injustice... And yes, they will not refund. We had to see people board, with plenty of time still left for us. And headed out. 100% do not recommend this airline... if you can book with another one do it. If you cant, well take this a sign that you have to be there one hour earlier and will only have 15 mins to check in. Then wait 45 mins to board...
reviews.author: Gabriela S

reviews.title: BAD SERVICE
reviews.text: They are constantly changing the times of flights making it a nightmare if you have connecting flights. You can’t even contact a customer service rep to ask any questions. I’ve booked 2 round trip tickets and all the times have been modified about 4 to 5 hours !!!
reviews.author: Eddie E

reviews.title: Inconsistent service, but might try again
reviews.text: We booked a round trip ticket from GUA to FRS. I didn't know anything about TAG airlines prior to booking. Upon booking, I was first alarmed to hear about the luggage size restrictions. My usual carry-on rollerbag was a few inches too big per the size requirements on the website. Luckily I emailed TAG airlines and they confirmed that my rollerbag would be accepted. Whew! The ticket says to check in by 2 hours before the flight. We attempted to check in 2.5 hours before the flight but they said we were too early. They said to come back for check-in 2 hours before the flight. Once we returned for check-in, they happily accepted all of our luggage. We had 3 pieces for 2 people. We knew we were going to pay for the extra weight, but the cost wasn't too much ~ $7 dollars. Security was a breeze for domestic flights at Aurora Airport. They didn't care about liquids in the bags so we could take our water bottles with us. Upon arriving at the gate, we only noticed 2 other passengers. We thought it was going to be an empty flight, but later more people started arriving. It made me think again that they weren't really strict about the 2-hour check-in requirement - or perhaps depends on the agent checking you in. Our departing flight was delayed for at least 30 minutes. There was a guy at the check in gate who didn't appear to do much. He would answer questions when approached, but it would have been helpful for him to make an announcement that the flight was delayed. Eventually we got on the plane. The space between rows are compact, but workable. If you have an oversized backpack, it may (or may not) fit under the seat in front of you. Mine barely fit, but it was a little bit of a struggle to fit it under there. Bottled water was provided during the flight. Arrival was easy, with luggage appearing within 10 minutes or so. As a side note, while we were waiting for luggage, there were a few guys on our flight who had large duffels as their baggage. Their luggage was definitely larger than the sizes mentioned on the TAG website. Go figure. Our return flight back to GUA was more expedient. They accepted us at check-in even before 2 hours before. The staff was more friendly and welcoming. We did have to pay the airport tax, couple bucks per person. This time our flight left early, meaning we took off 15 minutes before the posted departure time. I've never been on a flight that left early. Hopefully we didn't leave anyone behind. Upon arrival to GUA, it took a little longer for us to get our luggage. We probably waited about 15 min. I suggest that you do the online check in before arriving at the airport to ensure that they know you are coming. I still don't like that they are inconsistent about luggage rules and check-in times. I'm not sure if I'll take this airline again, but I will if I have to.
reviews.author: tropical_art

reviews.title: Denied check in to our flight more than one hour before departure
reviews.text: We were denied check In to our returning flight from Flores to Guatemala City. There were 5 of. The representative was condescending and very unhelpful. She scolded us for buying our flight through an agency. The manager did not offer any help either. We had to purchase new tickets as well as having to pay another hotel night, food and car rental. When we came for the flight the next day, they allowed people to check in up to 15 minutes before departure. Their own policy is taped on the counter that you are allowed to check in up to 30 minutes before departure. They probably oversold our original flight. They were unhelpful and dishonest. If you can use another airline do it!
reviews.author: Marta K

reviews.title: Baggage Nightmare
reviews.text: We took a short trip from GUA to Flores on Tag Airlines. The flight itself was efficient; however, upon arriving in Flores at 7am our bag was not there. They assured us that it would be on the next flight and it didn’t arrive (all day like this). The airline was difficult to get ahold of and the communication between employees was extremely poor. My partner spent several hours on the phone having to explain and re-explain the problem. It really disrupted an otherwise wonderful trip. On our last night, the bag finally arrived. The airline offered no compensation and took quite an effort to get the bag delivered to the hotel. We did appreciate the eventual involvement of the supervisor. We flew back to Guatemala City on Aeromar, a far superior experience. I would advise against taking Tag Airlines.
reviews.author: Joseph

reviews.title: Data about flight prices
reviews.text: They feed google flights with incorrect data with fake data which is unfair business practice to customer.
reviews.author: Pavol Travnik

reviews.title: On time performance
reviews.text: A Saab340 in a good condition and clean. Very fast check-in at airport. No e-check-in. No service during thw one hour flight. Professional flight attendant
reviews.author: George P

reviews.title: Customer Service
reviews.text: The customer service is horrid. I’ve been trying to receive an invoice so I can claim my travel expenses with work. It’s been a week with no response. You call the USA number - voice mail. You call the GTM number - they hang up. The plane is questionable on if it’s going to take off or land safely. The plane is questionable on the cleanliness and COVID protocols. DO NOT FLY WITH TAG
reviews.author: Kevin C

reviews.title: Just be prepared for bad customer service
reviews.text: They have the worst customer service. It’s a true shame they’re the only airline operating between peten and Guatemala City. A disgrace for the country. I’ve flown with them many times and always wish I had another options, the past few months have purchased over 20 tickets from them and have shown up for the flight from the jungle to the city (tiny airport, takes 3 minutes to get through) anywhere from 1 hr to 20 minutes before the flight leaves and have always been let through. Today I showed up 40 minutes before the flight left and they said I could not board because they close the flight 45 min before take off. Which is something new. I apologized and said now I know for next time and if they could please make an expecting, it was 5 minutes. They asked if I had prechecked online but i was never emailed an option to precheck. I was traveling due to a medical emergency and there was zero comprehension or understanding, They hadn’t even begun boarding. And I was less than 50 steps from the boarding gate. That’s how tiny the airport is. I asked if I could please speak to a supervisor and they had me call the call center. A call center! I asked to speak to customer service. Customer service is a joke and offensive. All they were interested in was the money to rebook me on the later flight. They charged the full price of the ticket to rebook. Felt like extortion. And zero comprehension for an actually emergency. It just makes me sad that ppl have to deal with this airline in what is otherwise and beautiful and charming country. Had it not been for the medical emergency I probably wouldn’t have written a review, after all I was 5 minutes late, but i received terrible customer service.
reviews.author: Eliza B

reviews.title: Good flight with no hang ups; even service was provided
reviews.text: We flew on a 1 hour flight in their Saab 340 fleet, which seats 34 people; the stewardess served us a snack during the short flight and the plane had a toilet! Seating was adequate, with reasonable legroom, especially in the emergency exits. Being quite tall (6'5") I found it reasonably comfortable, but would not want a long flight! The major issue was a very restricted baggage allowance, but the airline appears reasonably flexible about this, especially if the flight is not full. There was no in-flight entertainment, other then the other passengers! Overall, the airline does its best under potentially challenging circumstances.
reviews.author: TrevorCrichton

reviews.title: Guatemala GUA to Flores FRS - no issues
reviews.text: We booked a day tour with Gray Line Tours for a 1 Day Trip to Tikal from Guatemala. They purchased the airfare for us on TAG Airlines to Flores airport. Our flight left at 6:30 in the morning and returned at 6:30 in the evening. Check in was smooth at the Guatemala and Flores Airport. There was no web check in available - only airport check in. We had no luggage since it was only a day trip. The planes are small - the configuration is 2 / 1. Not the newest planes but we took off and landed on time. It was open seating. No assigned seats. Also they served us snacks (cookies and nuts) and a non alcoholic drink for the quick 45 minute flight. When we left the Flores FRS airport, they did make us pay 20 GTQ airport departure tax per person.
reviews.author: PandaHouston

reviews.title: To avoid at all cost
reviews.text: Really bad company. We paid for tickets with luggages included. It was already expensive. Then, we had to pay Again for our luggages even tho it was stated in our tickets that it was included. Of course, it costed $20 US per person (we were 6!!!). This is totally unacceptable and unprofessional. The lady at the counter did not know what she was doing at all. We ask to speak to the manager but she was not there and impossible to call her... Sure. We accepted to pay those extra fees but for sure we will NEVER take AGAIN this company. We left the counter really mad. After this fun episode, our flight keep getting delayed over and over. More than an hour! We are a family with 4 kids. I asked for free water as we have a delay but oh man, this is also impossible.... Conclusion : NUNCA MAS !! My advice : use Tropic Air instead, a reliable company.
reviews.author: alix p

reviews.title: Smooth flight, no hassles
reviews.text: Easy boarding, not problems at all. Smooth flight, more comfortable than most major airlines, was even room to stretch my legs. Would definitely use TAG for another trip in the future.
reviews.author: DudesAdrift

reviews.title: Worth the cost to Flores
reviews.text: We debated on taking a bus or flying to Flores. The bus ride is 8+ hours and the flight is less than an hour. It's worth the price! The airline is great. In Guatemala City, we had some of the best and nicest TAG employees check us in for our flight and give us some great pointers. It was very clean and the snacks on the plane were delicious.
reviews.author: Kristy J

reviews.title: They got me to/from my destination on time, the rest was much worse
reviews.text: My girlfriend had an emergency which would necessitate her missing our outbound flight to Flores/Tikal. She called three times, spoke to three different people, and got three completely different answers about changing her flight and prices. It's such a small airline, it's hard to imagine they even have 3 different people to take calls, but it's also mind-boggling that they would all give such different answers about how she could/couldn't change her flight and potential fees. They did end up changing her flight for approx $150 US. The return departure experience was terrible from Flores (FRS). There is an "airport tax" that only foreigners pay. This is never disclosed at any point by TAG, resulting in unexpected fees. Then they had two flights departing within minutes of each other. There was no communication in the boarding area and passengers from both flights crowded the one boarding area, intermingling with much unnecessary confusion over boarding. One single announcement by TAG staff would have simplified the entire mess. TAG operates one tiny turboprop, one medium-sized turboprop and one small jet. They advertise such on their website, but they don't clearly indicate which aircraft is used for which flight. In other words, be prepared for the smallest propeller aircraft you've ever flown on. If you're an aviation geek, that's fun and exciting! If you're nervous about flying, you will not be comfortable. The under-seat storage on both turboprops is functionally useless. Anything bigger than a purse will NOT fit, and like any flight, you cannot have bags in your lap or at your feet when you depart/land, so pack accordingly. Their tightly-enforced weight restriction for carry-on is much more likely due to space than load balancing. The service varies because of the differences between aircraft. Their smallest turboprop is serviced by a flight attendant and does not include a lavatory. Their larger turboprop and RJ are both served by a flight attendant offering routine beverages and snacks and have a lavatory.
reviews.author: Brad D

reviews.title: Quick , clean and they even give you a snack
reviews.text: The flight is advertised as lasting an hour but it really was a 30 minute flight. I was amazed that they even served snacks considering how quick the flight was. I was able to go and see Tikal and return back to Guatemala City the same day. Highly recommend it. There were no assigned seats on this flight, it's on a first come first serve basis.
reviews.author: Mio0111

reviews.title: Good for internal flights
reviews.text: The plane was in good condition and departed on time. A snack was served on board which was unexpected for this short flight.
reviews.author: Berty V

reviews.title: Experience on the plane & airport great, contact with head office not so much
reviews.text: I have used TAG various times by now to fly to or from Guatemala City/Puerto Barrios. Staff on the airports and on the planes have always been very pleasant and helpfull. Due to some problems with booking (creditcard would not be accepted by TAG's website for example) I got very little help from their main office in Guatemala City (better to say none: "The only option is for you to come here and pay personally." "So I have to get on a bus to Guatemala City to go and pay for my ticket, get a bus back to Puerto Barrios, so I can catch the plane to Guatemala City?" "There's nothing more I can do." Luckily, staff at the airport in puerto Barrios were willing and able to help.) Same with another issue we had when a volcano erupted and the airport closed temporarily: no usefull help whatsoever from the main office. Too bad, because it is a great service, it saves a lot of time, the airplanes are nice and as said the rest of the staff is super-friendly.
reviews.author: IngaInge

reviews.title: Booked a Flight/Hotel Package from Guatemala City to Tikal/Yaxha and it was great
reviews.text: Booked a Flight/Hotel Package from Guatemala City to Tikal/Yaxha and it was great. Maria Jose from TAG was great in making all the itinerary for us. Everything worked and the services were top notch. I recommend TAG Airlines because they seem efficent and very professional. There were no issues, considering that we were traveling in high season. Highly Recommended.
reviews.author: James C

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Knew nothing about TAG before taking this flight. There were absolutely no issues- check-in was easy, friendly and quick and going through security was a breeze. The flight left on time and was comfortable. We were worried that we would not be allowed to check in our luggage which was significantly heavier than that which is specified in the airline's online information but there was no problem and no questions asked. A very efficient airline.
reviews.author: meopi76

reviews.title: Tops a bus to Tikal!
reviews.text: We used this airline for a day trip to Tikal from GuatemalaCity. It was on time. No issues. We had day backpacks, so no storage issues. Pleasant staff.
reviews.author: itravel2000

reviews.title: TAG
reviews.text: Efficient and easy. Limited luggage capacity on this flight - we just took what we needed for a short stay in Tikal. The airport in Flores required fees and papers that were a surprise - be advised to be prepared.
reviews.author: Inspire819388

reviews.title: Flores  to Guatemala city
reviews.text: We have basically a connecting flight from Flores. We booked a flight with Tropic Air from Belize City to Guatemala City but seems we have to fly with two different airlines. Although a connecting flight, we have to pick up the luggage and recheck-in. In our ticket, we're entitled to check in 15 kg, and our luggage weighs only 12 kilograms. When checking in at the counter in Flores, they tried to charge us 20 USD per bags. I have a document with me I show to the girl who helped us. Although she doesn't understand what it says as it's written down in Flemish. She saw the 15 kg stated in the document, she took a photo from it. And from there we don't have to pay the luggage. But we have to pay a departure tax fee of 20 Quetzales per person. A small aircraft carry on 33 passengers onboard. No seat number allocated. Fly time to Guatemala City takes 45 minutes. Drinks are served but only water or juice.
reviews.author: Shavy

reviews.title: First time flying TAG
reviews.text: TAG is a regional airline of Guatemala. Like many airlines, they contract with other carriers. The contracted carrier in my case was CM Airlines. The planes were smaller prop planes of a couple different types that carried 20 -35 passengers. The actual departure times were substantially behind the scheduled times. They seemed to be more concerned with getting everyone on board and waited to allow people to get through the customs process when making a connecting flight. All flights were without incident and I would choose this airline again.
reviews.author: Mark H

reviews.title: small plane- but short flight
reviews.text: It is a small prop plane -not a lot of room-but the flight is only 50 mins so it is not a problem-sure beats the bus -reasonably priced
reviews.author: hali

reviews.title: Nice small airline
reviews.text: This was a small rotocraft airplane. We had a delay, due to the weather in Flores. The flight was very smooth and they even served snacks.
reviews.author: Alice V
